title: I Own It. But Can I Prove It? How a Laptop Sale Took Me to the Police Station
excerpt: I knew the laptop was mine. I had bought it, repaired it, used it for years, and eventually decided to sell it. But when someone claimed it was their stolen laptop and the police became involved, I discovered an uncomfortable truth: owning something and proving you own it are two different things. Here's what happened and what I learned.
